# watchpoint_oncall_schedule (Resource)

An on-call schedule that rotates a list of participants on a daily, weekly or custom cadence in an IANA time zone, optionally with time restrictions and extra layers. Referenced by escalation policy steps to page whoever is currently on call.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_oncall_schedule" "primary" {
  name                 = "Platform Primary"
  rotation_type        = "Weekly"
  rotation_length_days = 7
  handoff_hour_utc     = 16

  participants = [
    {
      user_email = "ada@example.com"
      user_name  = "Ada Lovelace"
    },
    {
      user_email = "grace@example.com"
      user_name  = "Grace Hopper"
    },
  ]
}

# Follow-the-sun cover in New York time: the base rotation covers weekday
# business hours, and a weekend layer with its own people sits above it.
resource "watchpoint_oncall_schedule" "follow_the_sun" {
  name             = "Payments"
  time_zone        = "America/New_York"
  rotation_type    = "Weekly"
  handoff_hour_utc = 9

  restrictions = [
    { days = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], start_minute = 480, end_minute = 1080 },
  ]

  participants = [
    { user_email = "ada@example.com" },
    { user_email = "grace@example.com" },
  ]

  layers = [
    {
      name                  = "Weekend"
      rotation_type         = "Custom"
      rotation_length_hours = 24
      restrictions = [
        { days = [0, 6], start_minute = 0, end_minute = 1440 },
      ]
      participants = [
        { user_email = "linus@example.com" },
        { user_email = "margaret@example.com" },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable schedule name.
- `participants` (Attributes List) Ordered list of rotation participants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--participants))

### Optional

- `anchor_utc` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp the rotation is anchored to; only the date is used. Defaults to the current UTC date when omitted.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `handoff_hour_utc` (Number) Hour of day (0-23) at which the rotation hands off. Despite the name this is read in `time_zone` (it was UTC before schedules had a zone). Defaults to `0`.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `layers` (Attributes List) Extra layers above the base rotation, highest priority first. At any moment the first layer that is inside its restrictions and has participants decides who is on call; the base rotation covers the rest. At most 10. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layers))
- `restrictions` (Attributes Set) Windows, in the schedule's `time_zone`, during which the base rotation is on call. Outside every window it is skipped (a lower layer or the base takes over). Omit for always on. At most 14. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))
- `rotation_length_days` (Number) Number of calendar days each participant holds the rotation (N weeks is 7N). Defaults to `7` for weekly rotations and `1` for daily.
- `rotation_length_hours` (Number) Fixed-length shifts in elapsed hours, overriding `rotation_length_days`. Unlike days, hours do not stretch across a daylight-saving change.
- `rotation_type` (String) Rotation cadence. One of `Daily`, `Weekly`, `Custom`. Defaults to `Weekly`. `Custom` uses `rotation_length_days`, or `rotation_length_hours` when that is set.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone every wall-clock field (handoff hour, anchor date, restrictions) is read in, for example `America/New_York`. Handoffs follow daylight-saving changes in that zone. Defaults to `UTC`; an unknown zone is rejected by the API.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) On-call schedule ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--participants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `participants`

Optional:

- `order_index` (Number) Position in the rotation (ascending). Server-assigned from list order when omitted.
- `user_email` (String) Participant email address (paged when on call).
- `user_id` (String) Watchpoint user ID for the participant.
- `user_name` (String) Display name for the participant.


<a id="nestedatt--layers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layers`

Required:

- `name` (String) Layer name, shown when this layer is the one on call.

Optional:

- `anchor_date` (String) Local date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) the layer's rotation counts from. Defaults to the date the layer is created, then kept across edits.
- `handoff_hour` (Number) Local handoff hour (0-23) in the schedule's `time_zone`. Defaults to `0`.
- `participants` (Attributes List) Ordered list of rotation participants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layers--participants))
- `priority` (Number) Higher wins. Defaults to list order (first listed is highest).
- `restrictions` (Attributes Set) Windows, in the schedule's `time_zone`, during which this layer is on call. Outside every window it is skipped (a lower layer or the base takes over). Omit for always on. At most 14. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layers--restrictions))
- `rotation_length_days` (Number) Calendar days per shift. Defaults from `rotation_type`.
- `rotation_length_hours` (Number) Fixed-length shifts in elapsed hours, overriding days.
- `rotation_type` (String) `Daily`, `Weekly` or `Custom`. Defaults to `Weekly`.

<a id="nestedatt--layers--participants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layers.participants`

Optional:

- `order_index` (Number) Position in the rotation (ascending). Server-assigned from list order when omitted.
- `user_email` (String) Participant email address (paged when on call).
- `user_id` (String) Watchpoint user ID for the participant.
- `user_name` (String) Display name for the participant.


<a id="nestedatt--layers--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layers.restrictions`

Required:

- `days` (Set of Number) Weekdays the window opens on, `0` (Sunday) to `6` (Saturday).
- `end_minute` (Number) Window end, in minutes after local midnight (`0` to `1440`). An end at or before the start wraps past midnight, for overnight cover such as `1320` to `360`.
- `start_minute` (Number) Window start, in minutes after local midnight (`0` to `1439`).



<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Required:

- `days` (Set of Number) Weekdays the window opens on, `0` (Sunday) to `6` (Saturday).
- `end_minute` (Number) Window end, in minutes after local midnight (`0` to `1440`). An end at or before the start wraps past midnight, for overnight cover such as `1320` to `360`.
- `start_minute` (Number) Window start, in minutes after local midnight (`0` to `1439`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_oncall_schedule.primary ocs_001
```
